review_type: independent whole proof and normalization review
checks: Both ordinary Hilbert class fields are Galois over Q; total ramification gives their intersections with F exactly Fi.
The common unramified extension has C6-conjugation factoring through both C2 and C3, hence trivial.
The central extension of a cyclic quotient is abelian; its inertia-fixed field is unramified at every finite rational prime and hence Q by Minkowski.
The two Hilbert base changes are linearly disjoint over F, proving h2 h3 divides h6.
The optional numerical C6 has exact factor 48/Q, with Q dividing 12, and is therefore a positive multiple of four.
scope: No class-number upper bound or p-exclusion follows from this lemma alone. The numerical C6 is not identified with an unproved cyclotomic-unit index.
source_checked: Louboutin 2004 Section 3.1, relative-unit definitions, all of Lemma 3 proof and the p456 analytic identity; printed pages 454-456 additionally viewed.
